verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's product docs state that including a Jira issue key in commits automatically updates Jira issue statuses, which is the core of the story. They also mention a built-in Jira UI and the ability to open Jira tickets right from the PR screen. The capability depends on the Jira integration and is evidenced only by marketing-level claims. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of linking PRs (not just commits) to issues, detail on how commit-message status transitions are configured, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
